spec_match.rationale: Maps indicators to the real Chromium csd.proto ClientSideDetectionType enum names (KEYBOARD_LOCK_REQUESTED=4, POINTER_LOCK_REQUESTED=5, FULLSCREEN_API=7, ...) and shows the specimen's real innerText; it is explicitly labelled as not Chrome's classifier.

interactive.rationale: Three presets plus 12 checkboxes rebuild the specimen; the trigger list, toy content-cue scan and extracted text update live.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index card describes exactly what the page does, including that it is a labelled model / manual observation where applicable.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers a legitimate fullscreen game (triggers with no scam wording), cues without API triggers, and a clean page; deliberately gives no score or verdict.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5094379441225728 plus the Chromium source or blog sources used.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's manual assertions (ESB gating, data minimisation, model swap) point at this page as the observation route and are honestly reported as blocked; no fake probe.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153 (Playwright CDP) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch. chrome-devtools-mcp is NOT available in this environment, so there is no DevTools-MCP verification and no accessibility-tree dump. Presets scam/game/clean and individual toggles changed #summary, #triggers and #cues as expected (scam: 4 trigger types and 4 cue groups). The only console output was the 2 expected warnings from the conformance panel's no-activation probes; no errors, no failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts scam-anatomy-readout-consistent (trigger list length equals the checked API toggles) on every update.

design_system.rationale: Only public/styles.css tokens; buttons that override background also set color; status colours (emerald-dark, rose) used only on light backgrounds.

accessibility.rationale: Native controls with labels, fieldset/legend, polite live regions and visible focus. However, the accessibility tree was not inspected with chrome-devtools-mcp, which is unavailable here.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Exercised at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x800: 0px horizontal overflow on both after the final edit, single-column layout on mobile, 44px targets.

openQuestions.title: Model the local DOM/visual and FORCE_REQUEST triggers
openQuestions.detail: TRIGGER_MODELS and server-pushed FORCE_REQUEST (Llama trigger rules) also start scans but are not toggleable here. Consider a labelled section explaining them, sourced from csd.proto LlamaForcedTriggerInfo.

openQuestions.title: Verify the KeyboardLockUniformPageDelay behaviour
openQuestions.detail: features.cc has kClientSideDetectionKeyboardLockUniformPageDelay (500 ms delay, 3 retries, colour range): Chrome may wait for a uniform-colour page before scanning after a keyboard lock. Research the host code and, if confirmed, add it to the readout.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-live polite for standard status updates, reserve assertive for critical ones; label every control; visible focus; 24px+ targets (bumped to 44px here).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Readouts and verdicts are aria-live polite (never assertive); all inputs are inside <label>; :focus-visible 3px outline; buttons/labels min-height 44px.
All dynamic output is built with textContent and createElement; no innerHTML anywhere, including the user-pasted JSON in the validator.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use minmax(0,1fr) grid tracks and overflow-wrap on long code/output so content cannot force page overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The .lab grid uses minmax(0,1fr) columns (two at 900px or wider); code, specimen and output use overflow-wrap:anywhere. Measured 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Honest educational anatomy of what starts a scam scan, grounded in Chromium's trigger enum, with no fake verdict.
